description: This file implements the OcdmSession class, which manages DRM sessions using the OpenCDM API. It includes methods for constructing, loading, updating, decrypting, and managing DRM license sessions, as well as handling callbacks for key updates and errors.

classes.name: OcdmSession
classes.description: A class that manages DRM sessions, including creation, license handling, decryption, and callback handling.

methods.name: constructSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with specified session type and init data.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: storeLicenseData
methods.description: Stores license data received from license server.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads an existing DRM session.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the session with license response data.

methods.name: decryptBuffer
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted buffer using the session.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption with optional sub-sample, IV, and key ID buffers.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the session.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the session.

methods.name: cancelChallengeData
methods.description: Cancels the challenge data process.

methods.name: cleanDecryptContext
methods.description: Cleans the decrypt context.

methods.name: destructSession
methods.description: Destroys the session.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets the status of a key by key ID.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Retrieves the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: hasKeyId
methods.description: Checks if a key ID exists in the session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for the session.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.

methods.name: handleProcessChallenge
methods.description: Handles the process challenge callback.

methods.name: handleKeyUpdated
methods.description: Handles the key updated callback.

methods.name: handleAllKeysUpdated
methods.description: Handles the all keys updated callback.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles error callback.
